targets.notes: The read-only core and Tauri command layer passed independent cargo gates, but this iteration did not launch a native bundle and did not automate or manually complete the system directory dialog through a real external-volume scan.
Representative token pairs pass their role thresholds and axe reports zero violations on landing and results states.
This iteration did not build or launch a Tauri bundle. The archived M0 native screenshot and historical native-run log are intentionally excluded from current visual proof.

Code review found no WebView path authority and no network, photo move, rename, timestamp, or delete command. Same-process pause/resume retains live descriptors only for the current run; report export creates a separately selected new JSON/CSV file and never grants photo mutation authority. UI text discloses possible filesystem-managed atime updates.

The production React frontend passed the 1024x768 browser boundary, but this required target needs a current native WebView capture and remains unavailable. Browser evidence is mapped to the optional inspection target.
Semantic and axe checks passed, but VoiceOver reading order, live status announcements, and the native directory dialog were not manually evaluated.

The original Guiying photo-and-check icon is present in the deterministic source and configured 512px/32px Tauri assets; both were decoded and inspected. This iteration did not bundle them into a new app.

Keyboard-only Playwright coverage reaches the explicitly labelled synthetic scan and results, exercises same-process enumeration pause/resume controls, and reaches the sealed-history export panel; focus indicators and focus restoration are covered.
The frontend production build and Tauri cargo check/test/strict clippy/rustdoc/fmt passed, but this iteration intentionally did not run Tauri bundle. No exact-current-tree .app or .dmg is claimed.
No Tauri native process was launched in this iteration. Historical process evidence is not promoted to a current runtime result.

The production React frontend passed the 1280x820 browser boundary, but this required target needs a current native WebView capture and remains unavailable. Browser evidence is mapped to the optional inspection target.

Current landing, scanning, compact/large results, paged-result with history export controls, historical-catalog and expanded raw-metadata browser captures were reviewed at original size. Their current SHA-256 values are mapped below; the packaged icon has its own asset report.
The direction contract maps signature evidence grammar, components, states, layout, accessibility, anti-goals, and repository ownership.

evidence.command: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm tokens:check && pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ui
evidence.notes: Twenty-eight tests pass, covering token-only root authority, same-process enumeration pause/resume and cancel races, enumeration completion during pausing, historical catalog pagination and result-token revocation, late-open isolation, per-token serial evidence reads, paged duplicate evidence, exact retry and stale-response behavior, terminal acknowledgement, cancelled-result locking, three-level raw-metadata review, strict JSON/CSV export payload/result validation, export queue/cancel/late-response races, parent-path rejection, and axe checks on historical and expanded raw states. Native locking, checkpoint, export target and cancellation semantics are covered separately by Rust tests.

evidence.notes: Sixty-five core tests cover legacy and bounded streaming scanners, descriptor-relative traversal, pause-safe enumeration stepping, same-process resume, pause/cancel dominance, short-read/change rejection and unforgeable current-session read proofs; the core exposes no mutation API.

evidence.command: Main-task local gate record: Store and runtime cargo fmt/check/test, strict clippy and rustdoc with Rust 1.77.2; Tauri cargo fmt/check/test, strict clippy and rustdoc with Rust 1.92.0; repository-external temporary target directory.
evidence.notes: Store 134, runtime 32 and Tauri 70 tests pass. No bundle or native run was performed.
